gaps.title: Root Layout Missing <main> Element (Critical)
gaps.details: Main landmark required for screen reader navigation. Breaking accessibility for all pages.

gaps.title: Form Error Messages Not Announced (Missing aria-live)
gaps.details: Validation errors appear visually but screen readers dont announce them.

gaps.title: Blush-400 on White (~2.8:1 Contrast Ratio - FAILS)
gaps.details: blush-400 (#c08e8d) on white fails AA contrast. Affects testimonials, secondary text.

gaps.title: Blush-300 on White (~2.5:1 - FAILS)
gaps.details: blush-300 (#d6adac) also fails contrast. Multiple light text options are inaccessible.

gaps.title: Date Picker Calendar Missing Keyboard Navigation
gaps.details: Calendar component doesnt support arrow keys. Users cannot navigate dates with keyboard alone.

gaps.title: No Privacy Complaint Process (PIPEDA Requirement)
gaps.details: Users cannot find how to lodge complaints with Office of Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

gaps.title: Terms of Service Page Missing
gaps.details: No legal terms page. Required for cancellation policy, liability limits, client confidentiality.

gaps.title: Viewport Meta Tag Missing or Incomplete
gaps.details: Mobile users cannot zoom or resize content properly without proper viewport settings.

gaps.title: No Telehealth Informed Consent Disclosure
gaps.details: Booking page missing consent form about virtual therapy risks, privacy, technical limitations.

gaps.title: No Color Contrast Audit Tool in CI/Build Pipeline
gaps.details: No automated contrast checker (lighthouse, axe) in build. Regressions undetected.

gaps.title: Form Inputs Missing aria-required Attribute
gaps.details: Required fields use HTML required attribute but not aria-required. Screen readers may miss requirement.

gaps.title: No Business Registration / Tax Information Disclosed
gaps.details: Canadian clients need to see Business Number, HST registration, corporate structure. None disclosed.

gaps.title: Excessive aria-hidden Use (May Hide Content from Screen Readers)
gaps.details: Multiple aria-hidden attributes found. If misused, this hides content from assistive tech.

gaps.title: Very Few aria-label Attributes (Screen Reader Compatibility Low)
gaps.details: Custom components may lack aria-label for screen reader identification.

gaps.title: 4 Links with Generic Text ("Read more", "Learn more")
gaps.details: Screen readers cannot determine link purpose. Links must have descriptive text.

gaps.title: No Automated Accessibility Testing in Build Pipeline
gaps.details: No axe, lighthouse, pa11y, or similar in CI/CD. Regressions undetected. Should run on every PR.

gaps.title: Cookie Banner / Tracking Consent Missing
gaps.details: No cookie consent banner. Website may be tracking without explicit user consent.

gaps.title: No WCAG AA Conformance Statement or A11y Policy Page
gaps.details: Accessibility statement missing from site. Users don't know about commitment or how to report issues.
